Ponyta

Fire

Kanto · Generation 1

Ponyta is a Fire-type Fire Horse Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 30 kg. It evolves into Rapidash. Its highest base stat is Speed (90), with a base stat total of 410.
